h: The Great Kiddush Draws Blessing for All Israel

p: they called the blessing over the fruit of the vine
So too in the zemiros of the Arizal,
even though nothing more is said
which is recited on every day as well.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
לְבָרְכָא לֵיהּ לְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וְכוּלֵּי
as it is written, 'One who robs his father and his mother';
and the companions have explained it."
And this is what they said (Berachos 35b)
about one who benefits from this world
HaKadosh Baruch Hu and Knesses Yisrael,
'One who robs his father and his mother,' etc.;
וְאֵין אָבִיו אֶלָּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וְכוּלֵּי
and 'his father' is none other than HaKadosh Baruch Hu," etc.,
וְאֵין אִמּוֹ אֶלָּא כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכוּלֵּי
"and 'his mother' is none other than Knesses Yisrael," etc.
That is, he robs HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
that is, the Anshei Knesses HaGedolah,
who instituted the text of the blessings.
on the end of the pasuk,
"he is a companion to a destroyer":
"he is a companion to Yeravam ben Nevat,
At first glance this is not understood:
at the beginning of Perek Chelek,
who have no share in Olam Haba;
עַל הָעוֹבֵר עַל מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה לְבַד
of someone who merely transgresses a positive commandment
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם)
according to what is written in the holy Zohar (ibid.):
דִּבְרִיךְ בַּר נָשׁ לְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
with which a person blesses HaKadosh Baruch Hu
to the Name of HaKadosh Baruch Hu," etc.
בְּכָל מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַזְכִּיר אֶת שְׁמִי וְגוֹמֵר
'In every place where I cause My Name to be mentioned,' etc.;
'May He remember all your offerings,'" etc.
it pours out to this bride," etc.
a gift to HaKadosh Baruch Hu;
and that is why it says "robs his father":
And we find in the Gemara (Berachos 7a):
the Name of the middah of Kesser.
"'And wisdom, from where (me'ayin) will it be found?' (Iyov 28:12):
from the place that is called the Holy of Holies";
for Ayin is called the Holy of Holies,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בְּכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת
as written in the holy Zohar in many places:
Yishmael My son, bless Me," etc.:
that is, to draw down the blessing and the flow,
as the holy Zohar cited above writes:
"to draw life from the Source of life
to the Name of HaKadosh Baruch Hu," etc.,
"and they come to draw from there
And this is what he said:
drawing down and flowing in abundance;
for blessing without qualification means increase,
like the first blessings in the Torah,
the blessing of the fish and of man:
"And the Sages praised the one with the wood," etc.,
sixty storehouses of wood are needed";
And it says "robs his father and his mother";
and according to the words of the holy Zohar,
it appears that "his mother" refers to the Shechinah,
as written in the holy Zohar:
And just before this it says:
and illumines the lamp that does not shine,
which is the lens that does not shine.
what we say in the zemiros of the Arizal:
in which is the life of all,"
which is the middah of Malchus;
and rise up to the head."
And according to what the Gemara says,
גּוֹזֵל לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
"he robs HaKadosh Baruch Hu and Knesses Yisrael,"
that it refers to Klal Yisrael,
from whom he withholds the blessing,
הוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
this follows what is written in the holy Zohar:
it pours out to this bride,
And when one benefits without a blessing,
of the blessings and the flows.

p: "he is a companion to a destroyer,"
at the beginning of Perek Chelek (Sanhedrin 10:2),
who have no share in Olam Haba
as we said on the meaning of
seven are the days of the week,"
alludes to the seven days of Creation,
and opposite them the seven shepherds,
And the Mishnah lists seven people:
עַד שֶׁאֵין לוֹ חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
that he has no share in Olam Haba.
until they wanted to count Shlomo;
and after the heavenly voice went forth,
"Should it be according to your mind that He repay it?",
they counted Bilam as the seventh,
even though he is not of the seed of Yisrael
And the expounders of allusions said
that even one who blemishes, chas v'shalom,
who were counted against the six middos,
And in the Mishnah they listed
It appears that the three kings
correspond to the holiness of the three Avos,
for the three middos of Chessed, Gevurah and Tiferes;
for indeed the Avos are called kings,
a feast like Shlomo's in his time,
you have not fulfilled your obligation to them,
for they are the children of Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov."
for there the whole world agreed," etc.,
And they brought proof from his feast
that all of them conducted themselves as kings;
all of Yisrael are called the children of kings.
And the order in the Mishnah is:
is opposite to, and the reverse of,
whose occupation was to convert converts,
that is, to draw the whole world to holiness
Who spoke and the world came into being.
And Yitzchak, according to his middah,
which was the aspect of restraint,
and it is alluded to in the hint
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב)
as written (Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of Vayeishev).
And Yeravam was the reverse of him,
for he wanted to draw everything to the kelipah.
were like the gravest that Yeravam committed";
and it ascribes it to Yeravam,
because he was the beginning of the corruption.
And this is opposite to, and the reverse of,
who was "the first of the converts" (Chagigah 3a).
And that is why it says "robs his father and his mother":
in that he does not want
for HaKadosh Baruch Hu and for Knesses Yisrael,
thereby "he is a companion to a destroyer,"
to the opposite of holiness, chas v'shalom.
וּבְשַׁבָּת אִיתָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
And regarding Shabbos it is found (Zohar II 88a):
the head of Zeir Anpin is filled
with the dew that descends from Atika Kadisha,
and it casts it to the Field of Apples," etc.;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ
And as written in the holy Zohar on this parashah:
this is the secret of the supernal Source,
above all, to pour forth," etc.
the beginning of being revealed outward," etc.,
and this is the supernal right," etc.
the secret of the middle," etc.
this is the left side," etc.
And it is the drawing of blessing
from the crownlet of the yud,
to the Name of HaKadosh Baruch Hu,"
with the vav of its spelling-out,
"Blessings upon the head of the righteous":
it pours out to this bride";
"and it casts it to the Field of Apples,"
that is, when one directs the blessing
And one who discharges the many
with the blessing over the fruit of the vine
draws the blessing down for all of them,
and he takes a portion first,
as written in the holy Zohar:
And this is what the Gemara cited above says:
with the blessing over the fruit of the vine,
and through this he will draw down for them
